question: Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education was founded in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1957**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE) was founded in 1957.
 
• It is located in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• The institute was named after the valiant freedom fighter Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi.
 
• It offers various undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma courses in physical education and sports sciences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of LNIPE**

 
 
• The institute was established with the aim of promoting physical education and sports in India.
 
• It was initially named as Lakshmibai College of Physical Education (LCPE).
 
• In 1973, it was upgraded to the status of a National Institute and was renamed as Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE).
 
 
 
• **Courses Offered**
 
 
• LNIPE offers Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed), Master of Physical Education (M.P.Ed), and Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Physical Education.
 
• It also offers diploma courses in sports coaching and sports management.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure and Facilities**
 
 
• The institute boasts state-of-the-art infrastructure including well-equipped laboratories, libraries, sports complexes, and hostels.
 
• It has facilities for various sports like athletics, basketball, football, cricket, hockey, and more.
 
 
 
• **Notable Alumni**
 
 
• Many notable sports personalities and coaches have graduated from LNIPE, contributing significantly to Indian sports.
